descByPlatform.chatgpt: Medium Shot Tech Conference Poster for SIGNAL AI 2026 San Francisco June 11-13. Subject: 4×2 keynote-speaker headshot grid occupying 12-88% x 30-60% y, eight diverse speakers (mixed gender, age 28-58, varied ethnicity) each with Subsurface Scattering Visible Pores Fine Micro-Textures natural capillary flush, against neutral grey-card background #3A3E44, moody Rembrandt triangle cheek lighting identical rig per cell, 4pt electric-blue divider grid rules. Composition: Rule of Thirds speaker eyes 38% y per cell, Centered 50% x hero vertical, AR 2:3. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 80mm LS at f/5.6, 1/160s, ISO 200, tripod, focus-stacked 3 frames. Lighting: Softbox Studio Rembrandt Key + Rim — 4×6ft softbox camera-left 45° elevation 1.4m per cell (key triangle cheek), 1×3ft strip rim camera-right 30° (rim), 4×4ft black flag overhead, 4×4ft white bounce below 0.8m (fill -2). Material physics: skin capillary flush, shirt fabric weave, catchlight twin-point eye. Typography: 'SIGNAL · AI 2026' 96pt Neue Haas Grotesk Bold electric-blue #1E90FF centred 50% x 18% y; subhead 'JUNE 11-13 · SAN FRANCISCO · 12,000 ATTENDEES' 13pt Inter tracking-250 #1E90FF centred 50% x 86% y; agenda ticker 'KEYNOTES · WORKSHOPS · DEMOS' 10pt JetBrains Mono #1E90FF centred 50% x 94% y. Color grade: DaVinci Cool-Signal LUT grain 6 +0.0 EV. Palette: grey-card #3A3E44 46%, skin 22%, electric-blue #1E90FF 18%, cream highlight #F4ECD8 8%, shadow 6%. References: Platon portraits, Wired covers, TED Talk stills. Exclude: busy background, plastic skin, warm skin tone, gradient fill, colour gel.
